capability: Lay out every link, row by row, to see what lies below
title: See every link below the top.

hook.picture: Close on the whale tending a few big cards at the top of the line. Far below, unseen, a tiny card cracks and a big card sags.
hook.words: We back the big projects we can see.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: We back the big projects. The break came from below.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: funding lead at a quarterly review

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three cracks rise from below, every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. Each sags a different top card.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: We only look one step down.

stakes.body: Money and attention go to what is visible, while the small project everything stands on fails unnoticed.

solution_hint: Lay out every link, row by row.

metaphor.body: The web of projects is laid out in rows: what you fund, what they use, what those use. Links run between rows, so a crack two rows down is traced up to every big card that leans on it.

steps.picture: The fog lifts row by row: row one the funded cards, row two what they use, row three what those use. Links drawn between rows.
steps.words: Every link laid out, row by row.
steps.sound: A bell per row, in tune.

steps.picture: Links become dashed joins where rows meet. The whale follows one thick link down two rows to the tiny cracked card.
steps.words: Follow one link down to the crack.

steps.picture: Push-in. The cracked card glows copper, and a thin copper thread lights up through the rows to every top card leaning on it.
The lit threads show which top cards are exposed. The whale ticks each one.
steps.words: Where rows meet, check the seam.

real_case.claim: The deepfunding dependency graph that sheaf-dep-ethereum explores lists 5,024 Level 2 dependency nodes and 14,927 edges around the Ethereum seed projects.

honest_limit.picture: The whale follows a thick link to a healthy card and a thin, faint link to the one that cracks next. The line weight said nothing about which would break.
honest_limit.words: A link shows use, not risk.

not_this.body: A map of links is not a forecast.

ending_pattern.body: The same top row, but with the rows below now in view: the tiny crack is seen early and patched before anything above sags.
ending_pattern.callback: The card that sagged in bar 2 stays level, because the crack below it is visible in the same framing.

end_belief.body: Look two rows down before you fund.

beats.picture: Close on the whale polishing three big cards at the top of the line, all glowing.
beats.words: We back the big projects we can see.

beats.picture: Far below, half in fog, a tiny card cracks. The line under one big card sags, and a pod using it answers with a copper ✕ chip.
The sag spreads to a second big card. A second ✕.
beats.words: The break came from something below them.

beats.picture: The whale peers down into the fog and can't see the crack. Hold.
Half a bar of stillness, then SERIES.open and the title.
beats.camera: still (half a bar of stillness first)

beats.picture: Pull back. The top row sits on a dense mass of smaller cards, mostly hidden in fog.
beats.sound: Room tone, then the problem motif once.

beats.picture: Three cracks rise from below, every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. Each sags a different top card.
beats.words: We only look one step down.

beats.picture: All motion stops. Faint row lines ghost in under the top row.
beats.words: Lay out every link, row by row.
beats.sound: The first clean signature: a clear bell.

beats.picture: The fog lifts row by row: row one the funded cards, row two what they use, row three what those use. Links drawn between rows.
beats.words: Every link laid out, row by row.
beats.sound: A bell per row, in tune.

beats.picture: Links become dashed joins where rows meet. The whale follows one thick link down two rows to the tiny cracked card.
beats.words: Follow one link down to the crack.

beats.picture: Push-in. The cracked card glows copper, and a thin copper thread lights up through the rows to every top card leaning on it.
The lit threads show which top cards are exposed. The whale ticks each one.
beats.words: Where rows meet, check the seam.

beats.picture: Wide. The real map: a short top row over a fan of thousands of small cards, in rows. The card fades in on clean paper.
beats.words: Real map: the Ethereum open source web.

beats.picture: Drift down the fan: most cards sit in the rows below the top.
beats.words: Thousands of projects under a few on top.
beats.sound: A low drone under the ticks.

beats.picture: The whale follows a thick link to a healthy card and a thin, faint link to the one that cracks next. The line weight said nothing about which would break.
beats.words: A link shows use, not risk.
beats.sound: The bell plays once and stays unresolved.

beats.picture: Slow push into the faint link that broke.
beats.words: A map of links is not a forecast.
beats.camera: one slow push to the thing that slipped

beats.picture: Same close framing as bar 1. The rows below are now visible; the tiny card's crack shows early, and the whale patches it before the big card sags.
beats.sound: A cracked bell, then a clear one.

beats.picture: The top cards stay level. Spark.
Three rows in view, the whale breathing above them.
beats.words: Look two rows down before you fund.

beats.picture: SERIES.lockup over the settled chart ground.
beats.sound: Lockup sting, then the room tone tail.

score_self.reason: Leaders feel the 'we fund the top' pain. Rows make the hidden layer visible. The numbers are the dataset's, not a result, and the card says so. The limit (use is not risk) is drawn.
